description: Get one or more random dog images, optionally filtered by breed and sub-breed (e.g. "hound" + "afghan"). Returns direct image URLs from the Dog CEO open-source image database. No auth required, MIT licensed.

breed.description: Filter by dog breed (e.g. "hound", "labrador"). Omit for a random breed.

count.description: Number of random images to return (1-50, default 1)

sub_breed.description: Filter by sub-breed within the given breed (e.g. "afghan" for breed "hound"). Requires breed to also be set.

name: dogceo.breeds.random_image

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Random Dog Image
